title: VLAN 20 missing on access switch
symptom: Finance PC gets IP in VLAN 20 range but cannot reach finance gateway 10.20.20.1 from one floor only.
topology_note: SW-ACCESS-2 uplinks to SW-DIST-1 over trunk Gi0/1.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
VLAN Name Status Ports
1 default active Fa0/1-24
10 SALES active Fa0/10
30 HR active Fa0/11

show interfaces trunk
Port Mode Encapsulation Status Native vlan
Gi0/1 on 802.1q trunking 1
Port Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1 1,10,30
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is not created on SW-ACCESS-2 and therefore not carried by local switching database.
expected_fix: Create VLAN 20 on SW-ACCESS-2 and confirm trunk allows VLAN 20.

title: Access port assigned to wrong VLAN

topology_note: PC connected to SW-ACCESS-1 Fa0/18 expected in VLAN 40.

show interfaces fa0/18 switchport
Name: Fa0/18
Administrative Mode: static access
Operational Mode: static access

50 GUEST active Fa0/18

expected_fix: Set switchport access vlan 40 on Fa0/18.

title: Trunk native VLAN mismatch warning
symptom: Intermittent reachability between VLAN 10 hosts across two switches and CDP native VLAN mismatch logs.
topology_note: Trunk between SW-CORE Gi0/2 and SW-ACCESS-3 Gi0/1.

show interfaces trunk
Port Mode Encapsulation Status Native vlan
Gi0/2 on 802.1q trunking 99

show cdp neighbors detail
Native VLAN mismatch discovered on Gi0/2 (99), with SW-ACCESS-3 Gi0/1 (1).
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch on trunk causes untagged traffic handling issues.
expected_fix: Align native VLAN configuration on both trunk ends.

title: VLAN pruned from trunk allowed list
symptom: Engineering users on SW-ACCESS-4 cannot reach server subnet in VLAN 60 while local switching works.
topology_note: Distribution switch uplink Gi0/3 carries multiple VLANs to access layer.

show interfaces trunk

Gi0/3 1,10,20,30,40,50
Port Vlans in spanning tree forwarding state and not pruned
Gi0/3 1,10,20,30,40,50
expected_fault: Required VLAN 60 is missing from trunk allowed VLAN list.
expected_fix: Add VLAN 60 to allowed list on both ends of trunk.

title: Wrong default gateway from static host config
symptom: PC can ping peers in same subnet 192.168.10.0/24 but cannot reach 192.168.20.0/24.

IP Address: 192.168.10.25
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.10.254

show ip interface brief
Gi0/0.10 192.168.10.1 up up

expected_fix: Correct host default gateway to 192.168.10.1.

title: HSRP virtual gateway mismatch

title: Wrong mask causes off-subnet gateway perception
symptom: A single engineering workstation cannot reach gateway and ARP fails for 10.70.70.1.
topology_note: Workstation in VLAN 70 with /24 design.

PC ipconfig

Subnet Mask: 255.255.0.0
Default Gateway: 10.70.70.1

show arp
Protocol Address Age (min) Hardware Addr Type Interface
Internet 10.70.70.1 - Incomplete ARPA Vlan70

expected_fix: Set host subnet mask to 255.255.255.0.

title: ACL sequence permits unintended guest access
symptom: Guest VLAN can access internal HR subnet despite policy prohibition.

show access-lists GUEST-FILTER
Extended IP access list GUEST-FILTER
